subject: Trading
title: The COVID Crash: March 2020
description: A micro-lesson that makes The COVID Crash: March 2020 usable.

hook.text: In March 2020, the S&P 500 fell 34% in 23 trading days—the fastest bear market in history.

buildup.text: COVID-19 forced global lockdowns. Airlines, hotels, restaurants—entire sectors saw revenue drop to near zero overnight.

discovery.text: Circuit breakers triggered four times in ten days. VIX hit 82—the highest level since the 2008 crisis.

twist.text: The Federal Reserve injected unprecedented stimulus. By August 2020, the S&P 500 had fully recovered.

climax.text: The fastest crash in history was followed by the fastest recovery. Those who panic-sold missed a 100% bounce.

punchline.text: The deepest fear created the fastest recovery.

quiz.question: How fast did the S&P 500 fall during the COVID crash?
